context_requirements: Expression of MTNR1A/MTNR1B melatonin receptors (low or absent in most immortalised lines)
An oxidative or inflammatory stress stimulus for the antioxidant/anti-inflammatory arm to be visible
Intact Nrf2/KEAP1 signalling for HO-1 induction
falsifiers: No change in NFE2L2 or HMOX1 at 24 h in any line
No suppression of NF-kB target genes (IL1B, CXCL2, PTGS2) at 24 h
No transcriptional response at all across the nine lines
Strong proliferation or cell-cycle signature changes at 6 h

evidence.supports: Ramelteon, a melatonin receptor agonist, reduces lung injury and oxidative markers and acts via IL-10 up-regulation
Agomelatine attenuates inflammation and oxidative stress and modulates the Nrf2/HO-1 pathway
2-Iodomelatonin (MT2 agonist) prevents apoptosis and reduces caspase-3 activation
Neu-p11 melatonin receptor agonist reduces apoptosis and oxidative stress markers in myocardial cells
